description: Java class representing a Client entity in the Fineract platform. It encapsulates client details such as personal information, account data, status, and relationships with other entities like Office, Group, and Staff. Includes validation, activation/deactivation logic, and various utility methods for client management.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a client with personal and account details, status management, and relationships to office, group, staff, and other entities. Provides methods for validation, status updates, activation, closing, reactivation, and data derivation.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new Client object with provided attributes.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the client data during creation.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Performs validation on the client data during an update.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a client, setting activation date and status.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the client account with reason and date.

methods.name: reActivate
methods.description: Reactivates a previously closed or inactive client.

methods.name: reOpened
methods.description: Reopens a client, marking the date and user responsible.

methods.name: validateNameParts
methods.description: Validates the name components for consistency and correctness.
